judge.rationale: The candidate ignores or directly contradicts several explicit requirements and acceptance criteria from the ticket. First, it names the frames and types `list_sessions` and `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor`). Second, it completely omits the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` configuration (defaulting the feature to always on) and omits `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`. Third, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`), explicitly violating the requirement and acceptance criterion to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame and have no code path sending an empty fallback list. Finally, it fails to cap `limit` to 1–200 in `validation.ts`, logs the raw store error message (which the spec and reference avoid to prevent leaking sensitive driver details), and omits the required `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` updates.
